question:
(a) Obtain the equivalent emf and equivalent internal resistance of $n$ identical cells connected in series in the same direction.
(b) Three identical cells, each of emf $1.5\,\text{V}$ and internal resistance $0.2\,\Omega$, are connected in series. Find the equivalent emf and equivalent internal resistance.
(c) State when series combination of cells is useful.

options.A:
(a) For $n$ cells in series, $\varepsilon_{\text{eq}}=\varepsilon$ and $r_{\text{eq}}=r/n$.
(b) $\varepsilon_{\text{eq}}=1.5\,\text{V}$, $r_{\text{eq}}=0.067\,\Omega$.
(c) Series is useful for small external resistance.
options.B:
(a) In series, $\varepsilon_{\text{eq}}=n\varepsilon$ and $r_{\text{eq}}=r/n$.
(b) $\varepsilon_{\text{eq}}=4.5\,\text{V}$, $r_{\text{eq}}=0.067\,\Omega$.
(c) Series is useful when low emf is required.
options.C:
(a) For $n$ identical cells in series in the same direction, $\varepsilon_{\text{eq}}=n\varepsilon$ and $r_{\text{eq}}=nr$.
(b) For three cells, $\varepsilon_{\text{eq}}=3(1.5)=4.5\,\text{V}$ and $r_{\text{eq}}=3(0.2)=0.6\,\Omega$.
(c) Series combination is useful when larger emf is needed and external resistance is large compared with cell internal resistance.
options.D:
(a) In series, $\varepsilon_{\text{eq}}=n\varepsilon$ and $r_{\text{eq}}=0$.
(b) $\varepsilon_{\text{eq}}=4.5\,\text{V}$, $r_{\text{eq}}=0\,\Omega$.
(c) Series is used to reduce internal resistance.
